deploy-bot: canary group B paused for preview-key-smooth v2 at 10:05 UTC
Riley: running replay: `./shadow_replay --topic=preview-shadow --shards=188-193 --from=2026-03-23T09:40:00Z --idemp=true`
ingest-bot: replay job 12077 queued, ETA 3m

Noah: followups: (1) rollout gate to block partition-key changes unless `shadow-compat=true`; (2) automated check in CI comparing partition metadata for main+shadow topics; (3) console alert for preview/invoice route_id mismatch > 0.3% over 10m.
Riley: filing ticket "preview-shadow-partition-compat" and attaching replay logs, assigning to Noah/Priya.
Noah: good job. marking canary paused until gate is added. :white_check_mark:
